3001.construction: adhi > adhy > addh + ā + bhāve + ti

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, saphalo upakkamo hoti, saphalaṃ padhānaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na h'eva anaddhabhūtaṃ attānaṃ dukkhena addhabhāveti, dhammikañ'ca sukhaṃ na pariccajati, tasmiñ'ca sukhe anadhimucchito hoti.

3002.commentary: (SNa) addhabhūtan'ti adhibhūtaṃ ajjhotthaṭaṃ, upaddutan'ti attho. imasmim'pi sutte dukkhalakkhaṇam'eva kathitaṃ.

examples.text: evam'etaṃ, gahapati, evam'etaṃ, gahapati! āturo h'āyaṃ, gahapati, kāyo addhabhūto pariyonaddho.

3003.commentary: (SNa) addhabhūtan'ti adhibhūtaṃ ajjhotthaṭaṃ, upaddutan'ti attho. imasmim'pi sutte dukkhalakkhaṇam'eva kathitaṃ.

examples.text: kena addhabhūtaṃ? jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi addhabhūtan'ti vadāmi.

3005.meaning1: half a month; fortnight; 14 or 15 days

examples.text: māso seso gimhānan'ti, bhikkhunā vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ, addhamāso seso gimhānan'ti katvā nivāsetabbaṃ.
sādhikam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, diyaḍḍhasikkhāpadasataṃ anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati yattha attakāmā kulaputtā sikkhanti.

3006.meaning1: lasting half a month; for a fortnight; for 14 or 15 days; once a fortnight

examples.text: acelako ce'pi, kassapa, hoti, mutt'ācāro, hatth'āpalekhano… iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikam'pi pariyāyabhattabhojan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati.
acir'ūpasampanno kho pan'āyasmā vacchagotto addhamās'ūpasampanno yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

3008.commentary: (ANa) addham'idan'ti-ādīsu addhan'ti ekaṃs'ādhivacanam'etaṃ, addhā idaṃ lābhānaṃ, ek'aṃso esa lābhānan'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (ANt) addham'idan'ti sandhivasena pāḷiyaṃ rassaṃ katvā vuttaṃ, ma-kāro padasandhikaro'ti āha, addhā idan'ti.

examples.text: addham'idaṃ, bhikkhave, lābhānaṃ yadidaṃ āraññikattaṃ … piṇḍapātikattaṃ… paṃsukūlikattaṃ… tecīvarikattaṃ… dhammakathikattaṃ… vinayadharattaṃ … bāhusaccaṃ… thāvareyyaṃ… ākappasampadā… parivārasampadā… mahāparivāratā… kolaputti… vaṇṇapokkharatā… kalyāṇavākkaraṇatā… app'icchatā… appābādhatā'ti.

3009.commentary: (VINa) addhayojane addhayojane'ti ekam'ekaṃ addhayojanaṃ atikkamantassa idāni atikkamissatī'ti paṭhamapāde dukkaṭaṃ, dutiyapāde pācittiyaṃ.

examples.text: antamaso gām'antaram'pī'ti kukkuṭasampāte gāme, gām'antare gām'antare āpatti pācittiyassa. agāmake araññe, addhayojane addhayojane āpatti pācittiyassa.
addhānagamanasamayo nāma addhayojanaṃ gacchissāmī'ti bhuñjitabbaṃ, gacchantena bhuñjitabbaṃ, gatena bhuñjitabbaṃ.

3011.meaning1: sacrificing priest; name of a group of Brahmans
3011.meaning2: sacrificing priest; name of a class of Brahmans
3011.commentary: (DNt) ayam'ettha pāḷi-attho, addharo nāma yaññaviseso, tadupayogibhāvato addhariyāni vuccanti yajūni, tāni sajjhāyantī'ti addhariyā, yajuvedino.

examples.text: magg'āmagge, bho gotama. kiñ'c'āpi, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā nānāmagge paññapenti, addhariyā brāhmaṇā tittiriyā brāhmaṇā chandokā brāhmaṇā bavhārijjhā brāhmaṇā, atha kho sabbāni tāni niyyānikā niyyanti takkarassa brahmasahabyatāya.

3012.meaning2: Chapter 7 of the Devatāsaṃyuttaṃ, Book 1 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

3013.commentary: (ANa) addhan'ti ekaṃs'ādhivacanam'etaṃ, addhā idaṃ lābhānaṃ, ek'aṃso esa lābhānan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: ñātīhi mittehi ca bandhavehi ca, balena vaṇṇena sukhena c'ūbhayaṃ, kathaṃ na hāyeyyuṃ pare'ti icchati, addhaṃ samiddhañ'ca pan'ābhikaṅkhati.
addham'idaṃ, bhikkhave, lābhānaṃ yadidaṃ āraññikattaṃ

3014.synonym: ekantena, kāmaṃ, khu, kho, nissaṃsayaṃ, nissaṃsayena, vata
3014.commentary: (NIDD I) addhā'ti ek'aṃsavacanaṃ nissaṃsayavacanaṃ nikkaṅkhāvacanaṃ advejjhavacanaṃ adveḷhakavacanaṃ niyogavacanaṃ apaṇṇakavacanaṃ avatthāpanavacanam'etaṃ

examples.text: yattha kāmā nirujjhanti, ye ca kāme nirodhetvā nirodhetvā viharanti, addhā te āyasmanto nicchātā nibbutā tiṇṇā pāraṅ'gatā tadaṅgenā'ti vadāmi
kāmaṃ kāmayamānassa, tassa ce taṃ samijjhati, addhā pītimano hoti, laddhā macco yadicchati.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, poṭṭhapāda, nanu evaṃ sante sappāṭihīrakataṃ bhāsitaṃ sampajjatī'ti? addhā kho, bhante, evaṃ sante sappāṭihīrakataṃ bhāsitaṃ sampajjatī'ti
et'ābhinandāmi vaco mah'esino, sukittitaṃ gotam'anūpadhīkaṃ, addhā hi bhagavā pahāsi dukkhaṃ, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso sadhano sabhogo kantār'addhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya.so aparena samayena tamhā kantārā nitthareyya sotthinā abbhayena, na c'assa kiñci bhogānaṃ vayo.
addhānakkhamo hoti, padhānakkhamo hoti, app'ābādho hoti, asitaṃ pītaṃ khāyitaṃ sāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati, caṅkam'ādhigato samādhi ciraṭṭhitiko hoti.
sabbattha sukhito hutvā, saṃsaritvā bhav'ābhave, anāgatamhi addhāne, lacchase taṃ manorathaṃ.
atītam'p'āhaṃ addhānaṃ evam'eva rūpena khajjiṃ, seyyathā'pi eta'r'ahi paccuppannena rūpena khajjāmi.

3018.commentary: (SNa) addhānapariññ'atthan'ti saṃsār'addhānaṃ nibbānaṃ patvā pariññātaṃ nāma hoti. tasmā nibbānaṃ addhānapariññā'ti vuccati, tadatthan'ti attho.

examples.text: sace vo, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, kim'atthiyaṃ, āvuso, samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti, evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe, bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyātha… addhānapariññ'atthaṃ kho, āvuso, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti …

3019.commentary: (ANa) addhānakkhamo hotī'ti dūraṃ addhānamaggaṃ gacchanto khamati, adhivāsetuṃ sakkoti.

examples.text: addhānakkhamo hoti, padhānakkhamo hoti, app'ābādho hoti, asitaṃ pītaṃ khāyitaṃ sāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati, caṅkam'ādhigato samādhi ciraṭṭhitiko hoti. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca caṅkame ānisaṃsā'ti.

3020.commentary: (VIN) addhānagamanasamayo nāma addhayojanaṃ gacchissāmī'ti bhuñjitabbaṃ, gacchantena bhuñjitabbaṃ, gatena bhuñjitabbaṃ.

examples.text: tatth'āyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo, cīvaradānasamayo, cīvarakārasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, nāv'ābhiruhanasamayo, mahāsamayo, samaṇabhattasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.

3021.meaning1: time of undertaking a journey; occasion of going on a road trip
3021.commentary: (VIN 2.5.4.2) addhānagamanasamayo nāma addhayojanaṃ gacchissāmī'ti bhuñjitabbaṃ, gacchantena bhuñjitabbaṃ, gatena bhuñjitabbaṃ

examples.text: tatth'āyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo, cīvaradānasamayo, cīvarakārasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, nāv'ābhiruhanasamayo, mahāsamayo, samaṇabhattasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
tatth'āyaṃ samayo diyaḍḍho māso seso gimhānan'ti vassānassa paṭhamo māso icc'ete aḍḍhateyyamāsā uṇhasamayo, pariḷāhasamayo, gilānasamayo, kammasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, vātavuṭṭhisamayo

3022.meaning1: for the complete comprehension of the long (cycle of rebirths)
3022.meaningLit: for the sake of complete comprehension of time
3022.construction:
addhāna + pariññā + attha + aṃ
addhānapariññattha + aṃ
3022.commentary: (SNa) addhānapariññ'atthan'ti saṃsār'addhānaṃ nibbānaṃ patvā pariññātaṃ nāma hoti. tasmā nibbānaṃ addhānapariññā'ti vuccati, tadatthan'ti attho.

examples.text: sace vo, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, kim'atthiyaṃ, āvuso, samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti, evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe, bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyātha… addhānapariññ'atthaṃ kho, āvuso, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti …

3023.meaning1: complete comprehension of the course (of saṃsāra); fully understanding the long (cycle of rebirths)
3023.commentary: (SNa) addhānapariññ'atthan'ti saṃsār'addhānaṃ nibbānaṃ patvā pariññātaṃ nāma hoti. tasmā nibbānaṃ addhānapariññā'ti vuccati, tadatthan'ti attho.

examples.text: imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañc'indriyāni bhāvitāni bahulīkatāni addhānapariññāya saṃvattantī'ti.

3024.meaningLit: discourse on complete comprehension of the course (of saṃsāra)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, puriso ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno addhānamaggappaṭipanno. tassa purato'pi'ssa dūre gāmo pacchato'pi'ssa dūre gāmo.
puriso sadhano sabhogo kantār'addhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya

3026.meaning1: travelling down the main road; journeying along the highway

examples.text: addasāsuṃ kho gopālakā pasupālakā kassakā pathāvino bhagavantaṃ yena coro aṅgulimālo ten'addhānamaggapaṭipannaṃ. disvāna bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ, mā, samaṇa, etaṃ maggaṃ paṭipajji.

3027.meaning1: travelling along the main road; undertaking a highway journey
3027.commentary: (DNa) addhānamaggappaṭipanno hotī'ti addhānasaṅkhātaṃ maggaṃ paṭipanno hoti, dīghamaggan'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā antarā ca rājagahaṃ antarā ca nāḷandaṃ addhānamaggappaṭipanno hoti mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso addhānamaggappaṭipanno. so passeyya mahantaṃ udak'aṇṇavaṃ, orimaṃ tīraṃ sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ, pārimaṃ tīraṃ khemaṃ appaṭibhayaṃ.

3028.meaning1: undertaking a long journey; travelling along the main road
3028.meaning2: undertaking a long journey; travelling along the main road

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhante, āḷāro kālāmo addhānamaggappaṭippanno maggā okkamma avidūre aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.

3029.meaning2: lives out one's lifetime; lit. causes to move through the period
3029.meaningLit: causes to move through the time

examples.text: paṭhamena vayasā anikīḷitāvino kāmesu yāvajīvaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caranti, addhānañ'ca āpādentī'ti?

3030.construction: adhi > adhy > addh + ā + bhava + nta
3030.commentary: (SNPa) addhā bhavanto abhisambhaveyyā'ti evaṃ piyappiyaṃ abhibhavanto ek'aṃsen'eva abhibhaveyya, na tatra sithilaṃ parakkameyyā'ti adhippāyo.
3030.notes: Occurs as addhā bhavanto. The reading is suggested by Bhikkhu Bodhi.

examples.text: kodh'ātimānassa vasaṃ na gacche, mūlam'pi tesaṃ palikhañña tiṭṭhe, athappiyaṃ vā pana appiyaṃ vā, addhābhavanto abhisambhaveyya.
tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, catūsu dvāresu dānaṃ dīyittha samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇ'addhika-vanibbaka-yācakānaṃ

3035.meaning2: settling of a case; settling a dispute

3036.grammar: masc, gen sg of addha, atta group

examples.text: hoti kho so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena tassa mahānirayassa puratthimaṃ dvāraṃ apāpurīyati.

3037.meaning1: not stable; not enduring; not eternal

examples.text: jātaṃ bhūtaṃ samuppannaṃ, kataṃ saṅkhatam'addhuvaṃ, jarāmaraṇasaṅghāṭaṃ, roganīḷaṃ pabhaṅguraṃ.
yatra hi nāma aniccaṃ'y'eva samānaṃ niccan'ti vakkhati, addhuvaṃ'y'eva samānaṃ dhuvan'ti vakkhati, asassataṃ'y'eva samānaṃ sassatan'ti vakkhati

3038.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of addhuva, neg
3038.meaning1: as unstable; as unenduring; as not eternal
3038.construction:
na > a + √dhuv + a + to
addhuva + to

examples.text: satthā ca me lokam'imaṃ adhiṭṭhahi, aniccato addhuvato asārato, pakkhanda maṃ citta jinassa sāsane, tārehi oghā mahatā suduttarā.
dasa'y'imāni, bhikkhave, kasiṇ'āyatanāni. katamāni dasa? pathavīkasiṇam'eko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ.

advidhā + ya

advidhā + ya

advidhā + ya

3044.meaning1: without duplicity in speech; without verbal contradiction

examples.text: saccappaṭiñño purimāsu jātisu, advejjhavāco alikaṃ vivajjayi, na so visaṃvādayitā'pi kassaci, bhūtena tacchena tathena bhāsayi.
itthī ca hoti itthisaññī sāratto ca. bhikkhu ca naṃ itthiyā vaccamaggaṃ passāvamaggaṃ ṭhapetvā adh'akkhakaṃ ubbhajāṇumaṇḍalaṃ ādissa vaṇṇam'pi bhaṇati avaṇṇam'pi bhaṇati
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, puriso daliddo'va samāno aḍḍhavādaṃ vadeyya, adhano'va samāno dhanavāvādaṃ vadeyya, abhogo'va samāno bhogavāvādaṃ vadeyya.
adhanānaṃ dhane ananuppadiyamāne dāliddiyaṃ vepullam'agamāsi. dāliddiye vepullaṃ gate aññataro puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyi. tam'enaṃ aggahesuṃ.

3051.meaning1: not blown; not fanned; not kindled

examples.text: taṃ hoti jātarūpaṃ adhantaṃ asandhantaṃ aniddhantaṃ anihitaṃ aninnītakasāvaṃ, na c'eva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ, na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammā upeti kammāya.
na bhaje pāpake mitte, na bhaje purisa-adhame, bhajetha mitte kalyāṇe, bhajetha puris'uttame.
yo ve anarahaṃ santo, arahaṃ paṭijānāti, coro sabrahmake loke, eso kho vasala-adhamo.

3053.meaning1: misconduct; immoral behaviour; unjust means; cheating

examples.text: na attahetu na parassa hetu, na puttam'icche na dhanaṃ na raṭṭhaṃ, na iccheyya adhammena samiddhim'attano, sa sīlavā paññavā dhammiko siyā.
evaṃ bho purisa jānāhi, pāpadhammā asaññatā, mā taṃ lobho adhammo ca, ciraṃ dukkhāya randhayuṃ.

3054.meaning1: false teaching; something opposed to the teaching

examples.text: evaṃ dhammā apakkamma, adhammam'anuvattiya, mando maccumukhaṃ patto, akkhacchinno'va jhāyatī'ti.
kull'ūpamaṃ vo, bhikkhave, dhammaṃ desitaṃ, ājānantehi dhammā'pi vo pahātabbā pag'eva adhammā.

3055.commentary: (VINa) adhammena vaggan'ti-ādīsu sace ekasmiṃ vihāre catūsu bhikkhūsu vasantesu ekassa chandapārisuddhiṃ āharitvā tayo pārisuddhi-uposathaṃ karonti, tīsu vā vasantesu ekassa chandapārisuddhiṃ āharitvā dve pātimokkhaṃ uddisanti, adhammena vaggaṃ uposathakammaṃ hoti.

examples.text: anāpatti ajānanto pucchati, gilāno vā na katheti, saṅghassa bhaṇḍanaṃ vā kalaho vā viggaho vā vivādo vā bhavissatī'ti na katheti, saṅghabhedo vā saṅgharāji vā bhavissatī'ti na katheti, adhammena vā vaggena vā nakamm'ārahassa vā kammaṃ karissatī'ti na katheti, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

3057.meaning1: not a legally valid action; not a legitimate vinaya procedure

examples.text: adhammakamme vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. adhammakamme adhammakammasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

idha, bhikkhave, yassaṃ parisāyaṃ dhammakammāni pavattanti adhammakammāni nappavattanti, vinayakammāni pavattanti avinayakammāni nappavattanti, dhammakammāni dippanti adhammakammāni na dippanti, vinayakammāni dippanti avinayakammāni na dippanti. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, samā parisā.

3058.meaning1: perceiving as not a legally valid action; regarding (something) as not a legitimate vinaya procedure

3059.meaning1: perceiving (something) as not a legally valid act; regarding as not a legitimate procedure

examples.text: adhammakamme vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. adhammakamme adhammakammasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
mā ca te, tāta, vijite adhammakāro pavattittha. ye ca te, tāta, vijite adhanā assu, tesañ'ca dhanam'anuppadeyyāsi.

3061.meaning1: not respecting the Dhamma; with no value for principles

examples.text: ye keci kāmesu asaññatā janā, adhammikā honti adhammagāravā, chandā dosā mohā ca bhayā gāmino, parisākasaṭo ca pan'esa vuccati.

3062.meaning1: conduct not in line with the Dhamma; unethical conduct; immoral behaviour; misconduct
3062.commentary: (JAa) adhammacaraṇenā'ti adhammakiriyāya visamakiriyāya vadhabandhanagarah'ādīhi attānaṃ vinipātetvā adhammaṃ caritvā yā vutti

examples.text: dhi'r'atthu taṃ dhanalābhaṃ, yasalābhañ'ca brāhmaṇa, yā vutti vinipātena, adhammacaraṇena vā.

3063.meaning1: conduct not in line with the Dhamma; unethical conduct; unlawful behaviour; misconduct
3063.commentary: (MNa) adhammacariyāvisamacariyā'ti adhammacariyasaṅkhātā visamacariyā. ayaṃ pan'ettha pad'attho, adhammassa cariyā adhammacariyā, adhammakaraṇan'ti attho.

examples.text: ime ca, mahāli, dasa dhammā loke na saṃvijjeyyuṃ, na'y'idha paññāyetha adhammacariyāvisamacariyā'ti vā dhammacariyāsamacariyā'ti vā.
adhammacariyāvisamacariyāhetu kho, gahapatayo, evam'idh'ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.

3065.meaning1: unethical and immoral conduct; misconduct and bad behaviour
3065.commentary: (MNa) adhammacariyāvisamacariyā'ti adhammacariyasaṅkhātā visamacariyā. ayaṃ pan'ettha pad'attho, adhammassa cariyā adhammacariyā, adhammakaraṇan'ti attho. visamā cariyā, visamassa vā kammassa cariyā'ti visamacariyā.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, gahapatayo, tividhaṃ manasā adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti? idha, gahapatayo, ekacco abhijjhālu hoti, yaṃ taṃ parassa paravitt'ūpakaraṇaṃ taṃ abhijjhātā hoti, aho vata yaṃ parassa taṃ mam'assā'ti!

yo hi, bho sāriputta, mātāpitūnaṃ hetu adhammacārī visamacārī assa, na taṃ seyyo, yo ca kho, bho sāriputta, mātāpitūnaṃ hetu dhammacārī samacārī assa, tadevettha seyyo. adhammacariyāvisamacariyāhi, bho sāriputta, dhammacariyāsamacariyā seyyo'ti.

3066.meaning1: because of unethical and immoral conduct; due to misconduct and bad behaviour
3066.commentary: (ANa) adhammacariyā-visamacariyā-hetū'ti adhammacariyāsaṅkhātāya visamacariyāya hetu, taṃkāraṇā tappaccayā'ti attho. tatr'āyaṃ pad'attho, adhammassa cariyā adhammacariyā, adhammakāraṇan'ti attho. visamaṃ cariyā, visamassa vā kammassa cariyā'ti visamacariyā. adhammacariyā ca sā visamacariyā cā'ti adhammacariyāvisamacariyā.

examples.text: adhammacariyā-visamacariyā-hetu kho, gahapatayo, evam'idh'ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.

3067.commentary: (MNa) kevalañ'hi idha adhammacārī visamacārī'ti evaṃ puggal'ādhiṭṭhānā desanā katā. purimasutte dhammādhiṭṭhānā'ti ayaṃ viseso. sesaṃ tādisam'evā'ti.

examples.text: tividhaṃ kho, gahapatayo, kāyena adhammacārī visamacārī hoti, catubbidhaṃ vācāya adhammacārī visamacārī hoti, tividhaṃ manasā adhammacārī visamacārī hoti.

3068.meaning1: unjust; unrighteous; who acts against the Dhamma

examples.text: tath'eva isayo hiṃsaṃ, saññate brahmacārino, adhammacārī khattiyo, so saggena virujjhati.

3069.meaning1: unlawfully accused; falsely charged; illegally impeached

examples.text: adhammacuditassa, āvuso, bhikkhuno pañcah'ākārehi avippaṭisāro upadahātabbo, akālen'āyasmā cudito no kālena, alaṃ te avippaṭisārāya, abhūten'āyasmā cudito no bhūtena, alaṃ te avippaṭisārāya, pharusen'āyasmā cudito no saṇhena, alaṃ te avippaṭisārāya, anatthasaṃhiten'āyasmā cudito no atthasaṃhitena, alaṃ te avippaṭisārāya, dosantaren'āyasmā cudito no mettacittena, alaṃ te avippaṭisārāyā'ti.

3070.meaning1: who is unlawfully accused; who is falsely charged; who is illegally impeached
3070.commentary: (VINa) pañcadasasu dhammesu appatiṭṭhahitvā abhūtena vatthunā codento adhammacodako nāma, tena tathā codito adhammacuditako nāma.

3071.meaning1: unlawful accuser; who charges falsely; who impeaches illegally
3071.commentary: (VINa) pañcadasasu dhammesu appatiṭṭhahitvā abhūtena vatthunā codento adhammacodako nāma, tena tathā codito adhammacuditako nāma.

examples.text: adhammacodakassa, āvuso, bhikkhuno pañcah'ākārehi vippaṭisāro upadahātabbo, akālena te, āvuso, codito no kālena, alaṃ te vippaṭisārāya, abhūtena te, āvuso, codito no bhūtena, alaṃ te vippaṭisārāya, pharusena te, āvuso, codito no saṇhena, alaṃ te vippaṭisārāya

3072.meaning1: following a false teaching; pursuing non Dhamma; practising something against nature

examples.text: evaṃ dhammā apakkamma, adhammam'anuvattiya, mando maccumukhaṃ patto, akkhacchinno'va jhāyatī'ti.

3073.meaning1: illicit desire; immoral passion; (comm) incestuous desire
3073.commentary: (DNa) adhammarāgo'ti mātā mātucchā pitucchā mātulānī'ti-ādike ayuttaṭṭhāne rāgo.

examples.text: pañcavassasat'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu tayo dhammā vepullam'agamaṃsu. adhammarāgo visamalobho micchādhammo. tīsu dhammesu vepullaṃ gatesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu'pi parihāyi, vaṇṇo'pi parihāyi.

3074.meaning1: obsessed with illicit desire; infatuated with immoral lust; (comm) with desire for the possessions of others
3074.commentary: (ANa) adhammarāgarattā'ti rāgo nāma ek'anten'eva adhammo, attano parikkhāresu pana uppajjamāno na adhammarāgo'ti adhippeto, paraparikkhāresu uppajjamāno'va adhammarāgo'ti.

examples.text: te adhammarāgarattā visamalobh'ābhibhūtā micchādhammaparetā tiṇhāni satthāni gahetvā aññam'aññaṃ jīvitā voropenti, tena bahū manussā kālaṃ karonti.
dve'me, bhikkhave, bālā. katame dve? yo ca adhamme dhammasaññī, yo ca dhamme adhammasaññī. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve bālā'ti.

3076.meaning1: considered to be immoral; deemed unnatural

examples.text: adhammasammataṃ kho pana, vāseṭṭha, tena samayena hoti, tadeta'r'ahi dhammasammataṃ. ye kho pana, vāseṭṭha, tena samayena sattā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevanti, te māsam'pi dvemāsam'pi na labhanti gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā pavisituṃ.

3078.meaning1: who doesn't speak according to the teaching
3078.commentary: (MNa) adhammavādī'ti asabhāvaṃ vattā. (ANa) adhammaṃ vadati, no dhamman'ti adhammavādī.

examples.text: evarūpo c'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo vuccati akālavādī'ti'pi, abhūtavādī'ti'pi, anatthavādī'ti'pi, adhammavādī'ti'pi, avinayavādī'ti'pi.
samphappalāpī hoti akālavādī abhūtavādī anatthavādī adhammavādī avinayavādī, anidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti akālena anapadesaṃ apariyantavatiṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ.

3079.meaning1: unrighteous; unjust; immoral; unprincipled; impious; against the natural order
3079.construction:
na > a + √dhar + ma + ika
adhamma + ika
3079.commentary: (SNa) dhammikā kho devā'ti dhammikā ete devā nāma, yehi mādisaṃ asurādhipatiṃ gahetvā mayhaṃ bhedanamattam'pi na katan'ti sandhāya vadati. adhammikā devā'ti adhammikā ete devā nāma, ye mādisaṃ asurādhipatiṃ navagūthasūkaraṃ viya kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā nisīdāpenti.

examples.text: dhammikā kho devā, adhammikā asurā, idh'eva dān'āhaṃ devapuraṃ gacchāmī'ti, atha kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi muttaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati, dibbehi ca pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricāreti.
atha kho, bhikkhave, tassa chapakassa etadahosi, yāva adhammiko ayaṃ rājā, yatra hi nāma ucce āsane nisīditvā mantaṃ pariyāpuṇissati.

3080.construction:
na > a + √dhar + ma + ika
adhamma + ika

examples.text: yasmiṃ kho, lohicca, satthari sāvako evarūpaṃ uḷāraṃ visesaṃ adhigacchati, ayam'pi kho, lohicca, satthā, yo loke nacodanāraho, yo ca pan'evarūpaṃ satthāraṃ codeti, sā codanā abhūtā atacchā adhammikā sāvajjā

3083.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of dhamma, neg
3083.construction:
na > a + √dhar + ma + ena
adhamma + ena
3083.commentary: (VINa) yo c'ādhammen'adhīyatī'ti. evaṃ brāhmaṇañ'ca rājānañ'ca ubho'pi adhammikabhāve ṭhapesi.

examples.text: ubho atthaṃ na jānanti, ubho dhammaṃ na passare, yo c'āyaṃ mantaṃ vāceti, yo ca-adhammen'adhīyati.

3084.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of dhamma, neg
3084.construction:
na > a + √dhar + ma + ena
adhamma + ena

examples.text: yo dussīlo dussīlesu dadāti dānaṃ, adhammena laddhaṃ appasannacitto, anabhisaddahaṃ kammaphalaṃ uḷāraṃ, na taṃ dānaṃ vipulapphalan'ti brūmi.

3085.commentary: (MNa) adharakāyo'vā'ti heṭṭhimakāyo'va iñjati, uparimakāyo nāvāya ṭhapitasuvaṇṇapaṭimā viya niccalo hoti. dūre ṭhatvā olokento hi buddhānaṃ ṭhitabhāvaṃ vā gamanabhāvaṃ vā na jānāti.

examples.text: so gacchanto na satthiṃ unnāmeti, na satthiṃ onāmeti, na satthiṃ sannāmeti, na satthiṃ vināmeti. gacchato kho pana tassa bhoto gotamassa adharakāyo'va iñjati, na ca kāyabalena gacchati.

3088.commentary: (MNa) adharakāyo'vā'ti heṭṭhimakāyo'va iñjati, uparimakāyo nāvāya ṭhapitasuvaṇṇapaṭimā viya niccalo hoti. dūre ṭhatvā olokento hi buddhānaṃ ṭhitabhāvaṃ vā gamanabhāvaṃ vā na jānāti.

examples.text: so gacchanto na satthiṃ unnāmeti, na satthiṃ onāmeti, na satthiṃ sannāmeti, na satthiṃ vināmeti. gacchato kho pana tassa bhoto gotamassa adharakāyo'va iñjati, na ca kāyabalena gacchati.

3090.meaning1: not remembered; not retained in memory; not known off by heart

examples.text: anuddiṭṭhaṃ idaṃ varaṃ, anuggahitaṃ idaṃ varaṃ, apariyāpuṭaṃ idaṃ varaṃ, adhāritaṃ idaṃ varaṃ, vinayo vā antaradhāyatu, ime vā bhikkhū apakataññuno hontū'ti upasampannassa vinayaṃ vivaṇṇeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

3091.meaning1: towards; up to; above; on top; higher; superior; very

examples.text: pa, parā, ni, nī, u, du, saṃ, vi, ava, anu, pari, adhi, abhi, pati, su, ā, ati, api, apa, upa, pahāro, parābhavo, nihāro, nīhāro, uhāro, duhāro, saṃhāro, vihāro, avahāro, anuhāro, parihāro, adhihāro, abhihāro, patihāro, suhāro, āhāro, atihāro, apihāro, apahāro, upahāro, evaṃ vīsati upasaggehi ca.
tiṭṭhañ'caraṃ nisinno vā, sayāno vā yāvat'assa vigatamiddho, etaṃ satiṃ adhiṭṭheyya, brahmam'etaṃ vihāraṃ idha'm'āhu.
sat'āsana-sahassāni, chattacchāyāya paññapiṃ, pacchimaṃ āsanaṃ mayhaṃ, adhikaṃ satam'agghati.
ayaṃ buddhattāya abhinīhāraṃ katvā nipanno, samijjhissati imassa patthanā, ito kappasatasahassa-adhikānaṃ catunnaṃ asaṅkhyeyyānaṃ matthake gotamo nāma buddho bhavissati.

3097.meaning1: in charge; in the primary place
3097.commentary: (VINa) ther'ādhikan'ti ther'ādhīnaṃ, therāyattaṃ bhavitun'ti attho. therādheyyan'ti'pi pāṭho, tasmā therena sayaṃ vā uddisitabbaṃ, añño vā ajjhesitabbo. ajjhesanavidhānañ'c'ettha dhammajjhesane vuttanayam'eva.

examples.text: yo uddiseyya, āpatti dukkaṭassa. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, thera-adhikaṃ pātimokkhan'ti.

3099.meaning1: name of a sacred bathing place

examples.text: bāhukaṃ adhikakkañ'ca, gayaṃ sundarikaṃ m'api, sarassatiṃ payāgañ'ca, atho bāhumatiṃ nadiṃ.
